grading: Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; key points: (1) Sept 30, 2026: fiscal Q1 2027 (13 weeks ended Aug 29, 2026) net sales USD 539.6M (-41.5% y/y) and net loss attributable USD 58.6M or USD 1.26 per diluted share (vs net income USD 199.3M / USD 4.12); conventional shell egg segment loss USD 71.0M on a 59.3% lower average selling price; (2) no dividend for Q1 under the variable dividend policy (cumulative loss to recover USD 94.5M); (3) buybacks: 66,601 shares for USD 5.0M in Q1, USD 315.7M left of the USD 500M authorization, plus 204,888 shares for USD 14.9M after quarter end; (4) Aug 31/Sept 2, 2026: new five-year senior unsecured revolving credit facility up to USD 250M (accordion up to +USD 250M), maturing Aug 31, 2031, undrawn. answer: Snapshot as of October 3, 2026. (1) September 30, 2026: Cal-Maine reported fiscal Q1 2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026): net sales USD 539.6 million (-41.5% from USD 922.6 million), gross profit USD 0.4 million, operating loss USD 82.2 million and a net loss attributable of USD 58.6 million, or USD 1.26 per diluted share, versus net income of USD 199.3 million (USD 4.12) a year earlier [H20-E1][H20-E3]. Conventional shell egg net sales fell 59.5% on a 59.3% lower average selling price (segment loss USD 71.0 million); Specialty Shell Eggs and Prepared Foods rose to 54.1% of net sales [H20-E1]. (2) Under the variable dividend policy no dividend is payable for the quarter; USD 94.5 million of cumulative loss must be recovered before any future dividend [H20-E1]. (3) Buybacks: 66,601 shares for USD 5.0 million in the quarter (USD 315.7 million left of the USD 500 million program) and 204,888 shares for USD 14.9 million after quarter end [H20-E1]. (4) On August 31, 2026 (8-K filed September 2) the company entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement: a five-year senior unsecured revolver of up to USD 250 million (accordion up to another USD 250 million), maturing August 31, 2031, with nothing borrowed at September 1 [H20-E2]. **Question:** What has Cal-Maine Foods reported or announced in the 30 days before October 3, 2026 about its quarterly results, shareholder returns and financing? Give dates and key figures.
*As of 2026-10-03*

**Interpreted as:** 'In the 30 days before October 3, 2026' read as the window 2026-09-03 to 2026-10-03, which captures Cal-Maine's Q1 FY2027 (2026-05-31 to 2026-08-29) earnings release and 10-Q, both filed 2026-09-30. 'Quarterly results' read as the latest reported quarter, Q1 FY2027 (fiscal year ends late May, so Q1 FY2027 is not calendar Q1). 'Shareholder returns' read as dividends declared/paid and share repurchases (buybacks) reported in that window. 'Financing' read as debt, credit-facility/borrowing activity, and cash position disclosed in that window. Company asked by name 'Cal-Maine Foods' = Cal-Maine Foods Inc (CALM), the SEC registrant.

| Q1 FY2026 (13 weeks ended August 30, 2025) | $922,602 [1] | $311,314 [1] | $249,184 [1] | $199,340 [1] | $4.12 [1] |

- Cal-Maine Foods reported its first quarter fiscal 2027 results on September 30, 2026, for the quarter ended August 29, 2026, and filed the related Form 10-Q the same day. [1][2]
- For Q1 FY2027 (13 weeks ended August 29, 2026), net sales were $539,607 thousand, down 41.5% from $922,602 thousand in the prior-year quarter (13 weeks ended August 30, 2025), as reported. [1]
- Q1 FY2027 gross profit was $403 thousand versus $311,314 thousand in the prior-year quarter, a decrease of 99.9% as reported. [1]
- Q1 FY2027 operating loss was $(82,165) thousand versus operating income of $249,184 thousand in the prior-year quarter, a change of (133.0)% as reported. [1]
- Q1 FY2027 net loss attributable to Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. was $(58,615) thousand versus net income of $199,340 thousand in the prior-year quarter, a change of (129.4)% as reported. [1]
- Q1 FY2027 diluted loss per share was $(1.26) versus diluted earnings per share of $4.12 in the prior-year quarter, a change of (130.6)% as reported. [1]
- In Q1 FY2027, Conventional Shell Eggs segment net sales were $201,683 thousand and the segment posted a loss of $(71,045) thousand, versus segment net sales of $498,433 thousand and segment income of $168,236 thousand in the prior-year quarter. [1]
- In Q1 FY2027, Specialty Shell Eggs segment net sales were $236,932 thousand and segment income was $14,937 thousand, versus segment net sales of $275,590 thousand and segment income of $64,196 thousand in the prior-year quarter. [1]
- In Q1 FY2027, Prepared Foods segment net sales were $62,995 thousand and segment income was $7,842 thousand, versus segment net sales of $72,368 thousand and segment income of $13,221 thousand in the prior-year quarter. [1]
- Pursuant to its variable dividend policy, Cal-Maine Foods said it will not pay a cash dividend with respect to the first quarter of fiscal 2027. [1][2]
- As of August 29, 2026, the cumulative loss to be recovered before payment of any future dividend under the variable dividend policy was $94.5 million. [3]
- Cal-Maine Foods repurchased 66,601 shares of its common stock under its current share repurchase authorization during the first quarter of fiscal 2027 for a total of $5.0 million. [1]
- The repurchase program permits repurchases of up to $500 million, of which $315.7 million remained available as of the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2027. [1][2]
- Subsequent to the end of the first quarter of fiscal 2027, Cal-Maine Foods repurchased 204,888 shares under the repurchase program for $14.9 million, a figure the 10-Q states was reached as of September 24, 2026. [1][2]
- As of August 29, 2026, Cal-Maine Foods reported cash and short-term investments of $767,592 thousand, compared with $924,057 thousand as of May 30, 2026. [1]
- For the thirteen weeks ended August 29, 2026, net cash used in operating activities was $(101,390) thousand, compared with net cash provided by operations of $278,604 thousand in the prior-year period. [2]
- For the thirteen weeks ended August 29, 2026, net cash used in financing activities was $(5,059) thousand, compared with $(114,181) thousand in the prior-year period, and no dividend payments were made in the first quarter of fiscal 2027 versus $114,163 thousand of dividend payments in the prior-year period. [2]
- Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash were $117,765 thousand at August 29, 2026, up from $113,542 thousand at May 30, 2026. [2][4]
- Cal-Maine Foods held its Annual Meeting of Stockholders on October 2, 2026, per an 8-K filed that day, at which Class II directors were elected and stockholders ratified Frost, PLLC as the independent registered public accounting firm for fiscal year 2027. [5]
